newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end slightly down on position adjustment.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end slightly down on position adjustment.

text.p: *Key June JGB futures ended slightly down on a flurry of position adjustment sales which appeared toward close. *Traders said there was some selling of cash JGBs from investors on the upperside. But otherwise investors were inactive ahead of release of U.S. jobs data, traders said.
